action.description: Work only with contacts that exist in your base, or also add new ones.

sendAt.description: Moment the messages should be set, in Unix epoch timestamp. If not provided, messages are sent right away.

shouldResumeAfterQuietHours.description: Whether to cancel sending messages which would fall within quiet hours, or let the system resume sending after quiet hours.
